boundary: Privacy / Confidentiality would be right if the callback stored, printed or transmitted the keys it receives, or if the script ran against another person's session, rather than discarding every key except Ctrl+Q in the user's own local session.
factor: a display-wide input hook that receives all keystrokes but records or sends none of them
note: The assessor read the hook's ability to see all key events as exposure of passwords to interception, but the code acts only on Ctrl+Q and keeps nothing, so no confidential input reaches anyone.
